content.title: Frozen Four schedule: Scores, times, TV channel, bracket for NCAA Men's Hockey Tournament
content.text: Updated March 29, 2026, 8:22 p.m. ETThe Frozen Four is locked in, and we saw a few surprises in the second round.After a lackluster performance in a 2-1 win over UConn, No. 3 national seed Michigan State lost to Wisconsin 4-3 in overtime to send the Badgers to the Frozen Four to play No. 2 North Dakota, which beat Quinnipiac 5-0.Stream select Frozen Four games live with Fubo (free trial)Denver was able to exact revenge on No. 4 Western Michigan for last year's national semifinals, defeating the Broncos 6-2 to unseat Kalamazoo's skaters. No. 1 Michigan, meanwhile, held off Minnesota-Duluth to advance to its fourth Frozen Four in five years.Here’s more information about the 2026 NCAA Men's Hockey Tournament and Frozen Four, including the teams participating in it, the schedule for the event, how to watch it and more:Frozen Four schedule, scores: Times for NCAA Men's Hockey TournamentHere's a breakdown of the NCAA Men's Hockey Tournament bracket:Games in chronological order. All times EasternRegional semifinalsThursday, March 26Worcester: No. 3 Michigan State 2, UConn 1Worcester: Wisconsin 5, Dartmouth 1Sioux Falls: Quinnipiac 5, Providence 2Sioux Falls: No. 2 North Dakota 3, Merrimack 0Friday, March 27Loveland: No. 4 Western Michigan 3, Minnesota State 1Albany: No. 1 Michigan 5, Bentley 1Loveland: Denver 5, Cornell 0Albany: Minnesota-Duluth 3, Penn State 1Regional finalsSaturday, March 28Worcester final: Wisconsin 4, No. 3 Michigan State 3, OTSioux Falls final: No. 2 North Dakota 5, Quinnipiac 0Sunday, March 29Loveland final: Denver 6, No. 4 Western Michigan 2Albany final: No. 1 Michigan 4, Minnesota-Duluth 3Frozen FourThursday, April 9National semifinal Game 1: No. 1 Michigan (Albany winner) vs. Denver (Loveland winner)National semifinal Game 2: No. 2 North Dakota (Sioux Falls winner) vs. Wisconsin (Worcester Regional winner)NCAA Men's Hockey Tournament national championshipSaturday, April 11National Championship: Frozen Four semifinal winnersHow to watch Frozen Four: TV channel, streaming for NCAA men's hockey tournamentTV channel: ESPN | ESPN2 | ESPNUStreaming options: ESPN app | ESPN+ | Fubo (free trial)The opening rounds of the NCAA men's hockey tournament will be broadcast on ESPN2 and ESPNU, while the championship game will air nationally on ESPN. Streaming options include the ESPN app (with a TV login) and Fubo, which carries the ESPN family of networks and offers a free trial to new subscribers.There are also a select number of games that will be streamed exclusively on ESPN+, ESPN's subscription streaming service.Stream select Frozen Four games with Fubo (free trial)When is Frozen Four 2026?Men's Frozen Four dates: Thursday, April 9 and Saturday, April 11The men's Frozen Four is scheduled for Thursday, April 9 and Saturday, April 11 at T-Mobile Arena in Las Vegas. The national championship game will take place Saturday, April 11 at 5:30 p.m. ET.Where is Frozen Four 2026?Men's Frozen Four location: T-Mobile Arena (Las Vegas)The men's Frozen Four will take place in Las Vegas at T-Mobile Arena, the home of the NHL's Vegas Golden Knights.Who's in Frozen Four? Teams for NCAA men's hockey tournamentWhile the Frozen Four won't be determined until the completion of the four regional finals, here's a look at which teams make up the NCAA Men's Hockey Tournament:National seeds in parenthesesAlbany RegionalMichigan (1)Minnesota-DuluthPenn StateBentleyLoveland RegionalWestern Michigan (4)DenverCornellMinnesota StateSioux Falls RegionalNorth Dakota (2)ProvidenceQuinnipiacMerrimackWorcester RegionalMichigan State (3)DartmouthWisconsinConnecticutFull Frozen Four scheduleHere's a breakdown of the key dates for the NCAA men's hockey tournament and Frozen Four:First Round: Thursday, March 26 and Friday, March 27Quarterfinals: Saturday, March 28 and Sunday, March 29Semifinals: Thursday, April 9 (Las Vegas)National Championship: Saturday, April 11 (Las Vegas)The USA TODAY app gets you to the heart of the news — fast.
